about: Visual effect ids used by skills.effect/vfx/extra. Deadlock's particle systems (.vpcf) are never read or copied: visuals reuse Risk of Rain 2's own effect prefabs and materials (Addressables keys checked against the installed catalog.json) or are built by our own code in Unity (kind custom: plugin/Runtime/Vfx.cs, made to look like Deadlock). kind: tracer (bullet line muzzle->hit), impact (one-shot at a point, scaled by radius when scaleWithRadius), ghost (attached visual that follows a mod-simulated projectile), orb (RoR2 OrbManager lightning orb), trail (vanilla DamageTrail fire trail), attachment (a RoR2 NetworkedBodyAttachment put on the hero), ward (a RoR2 BuffWard placed on the ground), material (a RoR2 material our custom visuals are drawn with), custom (built by Vfx.cs; addressable none), none.

ground area indicator: draws only where its dome meets the ground (the slam reticle)
Bullet Dance: spinning violet blade ring, afterimage trails, pink muzzle bursts and hit sparks
Seismic Impact: ground reticle while hovering, dive streaks, shockwave ring, dust and debris on impact
Lightning Ball: glowing core with crackling arcs, and a bolt to every enemy it shocks
Static Charge: pulsing charge ring on the target, then a thunderbolt from the sky

Thunderhead: a thick dark cloud deck over the zone, a dim haze darkening the area under it, lightning flickering inside, bolts striking down from the clouds all over the storm and onto every enemy hit

Afterburn: embers on enemies that grow with build-up; on ignition RoR2's Helfire flare and a burst of large flames; big licking flames and a glow while they burn; muzzle smoke and a flash on every Flame Gun shot
Napalm: a glowing flask trailing fire, then a splash of large flames, smoke and a burning puddle of Gasoline ground fire
big licking flames (Infernus fire: burning enemies, trail, pulse, blasts)
Gasoline's ground fire (Napalm puddle, Flame Dash trail)
Helfire's orange fire puffs (pulse rings, ignition flares)
RoR2's Helfire ignition flare on an enemy (Afterburn ignites, Torment Pulse hits)
Power Surge arcs via RoR2.Orbs.LightningOrb (Tesla type, like the Unstable Tesla Coil)
Phantom Strike: violet afterimage streak along the blink, a smoke puff where she left and arrives, slash arcs and hit flashes on each cut

Shoulder Charge: Abrams rockets forward: a hot yellow glow and sparks at his front (moment loop, turned to face the charge), thin yellow trails off his shoulders and a core streak behind, dust kicked up at his feet; a launch burst of dust and a yellow ring and flash as he sets off (cast)
Haymaker: fist glow and embers during the wind-up, a red streak on the lunge, an impact shockwave, dust and sparks on the punch
Power Surge: blue crackle and glow around Seven and his gun while it runs, a flash on cast
Torment Pulse: a ring of fire racing out along the ground to the pulse radius every pulse, embers and heat glow around Infernus
Flame Dash: flames licking around Infernus' legs while he dashes, and burning patches of ground fire along his path that last as long as the trail
Concussive Combustion: a fire glow and embers building on Infernus through the fuse, then a fireball, a racing ring of flame, smoke and a burning ground
Sleep Dagger in flight: a violet glow and trail that always shows, with or without the knife model
